A recent leak has revealed that one of the most popular Apple Watch faces — Modular — will gain several new color customization options in watchOS 27. Here are the details.

Modular watch face to gain new color customization options in watchOS 27

Apple is expanding customization options for the Modular face in watchOS 27.

Modular has become a favorite for many users thanks to its flexibility. In addition to offering a large number of complication slots, users can personalize the look of the face with multiple color options.

Aaron Perris recently discovered that iOS 27 beta 5 reveals nine new Modular color options coming to watchOS 27.

The beta version does not yet include previews of these nine new colors. However, Perris found their names hidden in the beta code.

Some of these new colors may be intended to preview new bands for the upcoming Apple Watch Series 12 or Apple Watch Ultra 4 launching next month.

Speaking of which, Mark Gurman previously reported that Apple is working on a brand-new Modular face in watchOS 27, inspired by the Modular Ultra.
